provenance.source_title: The Economics Of Owning A Shopping Mall

voice_persona.name: 冷静的商业不动产系统解说员
voice_persona.description: 一位把'收租神话'拆成合同、条款与现金流的解说者：对大众迷信的指标（入住率/面积）保持职业怀疑，每个反直觉结论都落到合同语言或租约数字上；讲死亡案例时用财经记者的克制而非鬼故事渲染；长句承载机制链条，短句专供宣判
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作潜在买家与日常消费者的双重身份：既帮其尽调，也帮其看懂自己每天逛的空间是如何被设计的
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自合同机制、分析师研究与真实案例的时间线与价格，语气克制（typically/in effect/roughly）

tone_profile.certainty_style: 机制与合同直接肯定；案例数字注明年份语境；趋势判断避免绝对化；宣判用短句

rhythm_rules.rule: 长句承载机制链条（长句占比约42%），短句专供宣判（Occupancy is not the same thing as income.）
惊人比例后用'Read that again.'式命令句固定
rhythm_rules.function: 把最反常识的数字钉成记忆点

rhythm_rules.rule: 机制层叠后必用重定义宣判收束（租客流/位置>面积/人流才是生意）
rhythm_rules.function: 每层给观众一个可带走的判断

rhythm_rules.rule: 时间对照揭示延迟成本（买楼那天看不到，离开那天看到）
rhythm_rules.function: 把合同风险翻译成时间体验

rhythm_rules.rule: 案例叙述用时间线推进（开业→巅峰→序列衰退→空楼→拆除→新用途）
rhythm_rules.function: 让机制在真实生命周期上验证

pause_and_emphasis: 反转前用'Here's where it gets interesting'式路标
惊人数字后用'Read that again.'式命令停顿
陷阱前用'Here's the trap almost nobody sees coming'式预警
transition_style: 延迟正题预告（Before we get to how malls die, it's worth understanding...）
另一侧账本召唤（Now, here's the other side of the ledger.）
案例引入（it helps to look at one real mall from opening day to demolition）
根本原因设问（didn't happen in a vacuum...）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：开场急刹与个别反讽，机制与案例段不用
placement_rules: 开场幻觉后的重复句式急刹（Sounds simple. It is not simple.）
'不是鬼故事频道而是财经频道'式的自我定位反讽
avoid_rules: 不调侃倒闭商户与失业
不用段子冲淡衰亡案例的沉重

language_patterns.formula: Sounds simple. It is not simple.
language_patterns.purpose: 用重复句式否定截断幻想

language_patterns.formula: you're not really buying a building, you're buying a bet on a neighborhood
language_patterns.purpose: 把收购对象从不动产重定义为赌注

language_patterns.formula: buy shares ... for the price of a cup of coffee
language_patterns.purpose: 用日常价格解释金融门槛

language_patterns.formula: You don't see this cost on the day you buy. You see it the day your anchor tenant leaves.
language_patterns.purpose: 用时间对照揭示延迟爆发的合同成本

language_patterns.formula: The owner isn't renting square footage to the anchor. The owner is renting foot traffic from the anchor.
language_patterns.purpose: 颠覆交易方向以揭示真实价值流

language_patterns.formula: Size and rent are not the same thing in this business. Position is worth more than space.
language_patterns.purpose: 用对偶宣判重置价值逻辑

language_patterns.formula: Occupancy is not the same thing as income.
language_patterns.purpose: 直接否定行业迷信指标

language_patterns.formula: It fails because one piece falls out and the rest was quietly built to depend on that piece.
language_patterns.purpose: 把失败归因从普遍衰退改为依赖崩塌

language_patterns.formula: It took less than two decades to go from that number to a pile of rubble.
language_patterns.purpose: 用时间跨度量化崩塌速度

language_patterns.formula: The [设施]'s original reason for existing, [产品], simply stopped being unique to [设施].
language_patterns.purpose: 用原始产品失效解释行业级死亡

language_patterns.formula: A [设施] used to sell products. The ones that survived started selling reasons to physically leave the house.
language_patterns.purpose: 用'卖X→卖Y'概括幸存者策略

language_patterns.formula: The building isn't really the business. The people walking through it are.
language_patterns.purpose: 结尾把资产重定义为流经它的人

preferred_traits: 合同与租约术语通俗并用（anchor lease、co-tenancy、breakpoint、CAM、REIT）
单位化数字（per square foot per year、$5 vs $50）
时间线与价格的事实陈述（opened in 1975、sold for $1.6 million）
avoid_traits: 对倒闭商户的戏剧化渲染

forbidden_style.rule: 合同机制陈述不构成法律意见，案例数字注明年份
衰亡案例保持财经记者的克制，不渲染鬼故事
不把行业趋势（网购）描述为绝对宿命
禁止编造数字、案例或合同条款
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
